text.tspan: The late-bound part: the requirements URN = repo + environment_setup_commit (frozen, dataset) + path (floating, package version). Assembled per invocation; content never stored on our side.

With declared images (image-manifest.txt) and the dataset snapshot, EVAL genuinely needs only: image + patch + eval script. The red dashed fetch feeds a script that never runs — it is the only network touch and the only unfrozen input left in the marking path (dies with the planned swebench fork).
